notes: Vapid's Montagne XL is an SUV styled after the second-generation Ford Explorer. New to the series in GTA 6, it seats four.

name: Vapid Police Cruiser (Stanier LE)
notes: The police version of the Vapid Stanier G2, used by Leonida law enforcement. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

name: Vapid Police Ghost (Stanier LE)
notes: The police version of the Vapid Stanier G2, used by Leonida law enforcement. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

name: Vapid Police Lowline
notes: The police version of the Vapid Lowline, used by Leonida law enforcement. A series regular, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

name: Vapid Police Montagne
notes: The police version of the Vapid Montagne, used by Leonida law enforcement. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats four.

name: Vapid Reclaimer
notes: Vapid's Reclaimer is an off-roader styled after the 2019-2023 Ford Ranger (T6). New to the series in GTA 6, it seats four.

name: Vapid Reclaimer '70s
notes: A 1970s-era Vapid off-roader that shares its name with the modern Reclaimer pickup. It is new in GTA 6 and has no tracker fitted.

name: Vapid Riata Classic
notes: Vapid's Riata Classic is an SUV styled after the first-generation Ford Bronco. New to the series in GTA 6, it seats two.

name: Vapid Rumpo
notes: The Vapid Rumpo is a van with the look of the Ford E-Series. A series regular, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

name: Vapid Sadler
notes: The Vapid Sadler is a utility vehicle with the look of the first Generation Ford F250 Super Duty. A series regular, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

name: Vapid Liberator
notes: The Vapid Liberator is an off-roader with the look of the fourth-generation Ford Super Duty. A series regular, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

name: Vapid Sandking XL
notes: An off-roader from Vapid, modelled on the Ford Super Duty. Returning from past games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

name: Vapid Sandking XT
notes: The Vapid Sandking XT is an off-roader with the look of the fourth-generation Ford Super Duty (2020 F-450). First appearing in GTA 6, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

name: Vapid Shifter
notes: A van from Vapid, modelled on the fourth-generation Ford Transit. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats two.

name: Vapid Shuttle
notes: The Vapid Shuttle is a van with the look of the fourth-generation Ford Transit. First appearing in GTA 6, it carries ten people.

name: Vapid Slamvan '56
notes: A 1950s muscle car from Vapid, modelled on the Rat-rodded 1953-1956 Ford F-Series pickup. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

name: Vapid Speedo
notes: The Vapid Speedo is a van with the look of the 2003-present Chevrolet Express van. A series regular, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

name: Vapid Stanier '98
notes: A 1990s sedan from Vapid, modelled on the Ford Crown Victoria. Returning from past games, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

name: Vapid Stanier G2
notes: A late-1990s Vapid four-door in the Crown Victoria mould, seen often in pre-launch footage. It may be the same car that appears in the game as the Stanier '98.

name: Vapid Stanier G2 (donk)
notes: The late-1990s Vapid Stanier sedan raised on huge wheels in classic donk style, first spotted in Trailer 1.

name: Vapid Stanier Taxi
notes: The taxi version of the Vapid Stanier '98, working as a cab around Leonida. Returning from past games, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

name: Vapid Tow Truck
notes: A utility vehicle, spotted in Trailer 1.

name: Vice City Metro Mule
notes: The Vice City Metro Mule is a service vehicle with the look of the Innovia APM 100. It is new to the series in GTA 6.

name: Vulcar Ingot
notes: Vulcar's Ingot is a sedan styled after the VW Passat wagon. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats four and uses front-wheel drive.

name: Vysser Neo
notes: The Vysser Neo is a sports car with the look of the Spyker C8 Aileron. A series regular, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

name: Western Cliffhanger
notes: A stripped-down, flat-track inspired stunt motorcycle built for high-torque hill climbing and agile off-road trail riding.

name: Western Company Duster
notes: A plane from Western Company, modelled on the Stearman Model 75. Returning from past games, it carries two people.

name: Western Nightblade
notes: Western Motorcycle Company's Nightblade is a motorbike styled after the Harley-Davidson Night Rod Special. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two.

name: Western Sovereign 107
notes: A motorbike from Western Motorcycle Company, modelled on the Harley Davidson Road King. Returning from past games, it has room for the rider only.

name: Western Sovereign 107 Police
notes: The police version of the Western Sovereign 107, a motorbike built for law enforcement on Leonida's roads. Back from earlier GTA games, it has room for the rider only.

name: Western Zombie Chopper
notes: Western Motorcycle Company's Zombie Chopper is a motorbike styled after the Harley Davidson Fat Bob Custom. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two.

name: Willard Faction Custom Donk
notes: The Willard Faction Custom Donk is a muscle car with the look of the 1982-1987 Buick Regal. A series regular, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

name: Willard Grouse '92
notes: Willard's Grouse '92 is a 1990s sedan styled after the 1992-1995 Buick Skylark. New to the series in GTA 6, it seats four.

name: Willard Lasso '90
notes: The Willard Lasso '90 is a 1990s coupe with the look of the 1990-1991 Buick Reatta convertible. First appearing in GTA 6, it seats two.

name: Willard Moocher '83
notes: Willard's Moocher '83 is a 1980s van styled after the 1985 Fleetwood Southwind. New to the series in GTA 6, it seats four.

name: Willard Transient
notes: A sedan from Willard, modelled on the sixth-generation Buick Regal. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats four.

name: Willard Trotter '95
notes: The Willard Trotter '95 is a 1990s van with the look of the Rexhall RoseAir. GTA 6 is its first appearance in the series.

name: Yakuruna
notes: The Yakuruna is a boat with the look of the Riva 86 Domino. GTA 6 is its first appearance in the series.

name: Zirconium Stratum
notes: A sedan from Zirconium, modelled on the Honda Accord station wagon. Returning from past games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.
